title: LoadRunIndex
description: One load run's complete result, as persisted to `load-result.json`.

canaries.description: The run's health canaries — the cross-call signals a triager scans first.

checks.description:
Per-scenario Test-case check-verdict tally over the SAMPLED calls (the
per-sample oracle): how many sampled calls passed all their checks vs
failed at least one. Empty when no case with checks was attached.

counts.description:
Per-`(scenario, class, case)` completed-call counts (the report's main
table). A row's `ok` marks its class as no failure (`ok`: the call ended
on an accepted branch).

ladders.description: Per scenario, the message ladder of its calls.

meta.description: Run metadata: when it ran and the echoed knobs it ran with.

progress.description: The run's headline figures as of this doc.

rateEvents.description: Every offered-rate change and drain, oldest first (bounded).

rateEventsDropped.description: Rate events past the bound, not listed in `rate_events`.

recentFailures.description: The last failed calls, oldest first (bounded).

recording.description: Per scenario: the calls placed, recorded and judged on their recording.

samples.description:
Links to the stored sampled callflow pages, grouped by their
`(scenario, class, case)` bucket. Paths are RELATIVE to the run dir.

series.description:
The run's time series, oldest first: one point per window, every
window of the run covered (adjacent windows merge as the run grows).

Canaries.description: The run's cross-call health canaries — the first things a triager scans.

dropsIn.description:
Inbound datagrams discarded by the simulated packet-loss model (0 when
loss is off).

dropsOut.description: Outbound datagrams discarded by the simulated packet-loss model.

inboxDrops.description: Correlated datagrams discarded because their call's inbox was full.

orphans.description:
Inbound datagrams that matched no live call (a post-failover stray-send
burst is the classic SUT reclaim bug; should be ~0 in a clean run).

ringingExpected.description: Calls that reached the ring→answer step (the 18x-delivery denominator).

ringingReceived.description:
Of those, how many saw the 18x ringing provisional (numerator). A dropped
non-PRACK 18x is expected, so this is a RATE gated at >99%, not a per-call
failure.

shed.description: Offered calls dropped at the max-in-flight cap (offered load we shed).

CheckSummaryRow.description: Per-scenario Test-case check-verdict tally over the sampled calls.

failed.description: Sampled calls with at least one failing check (the `check_fail` class).

passed.description: Sampled calls whose every attached check passed.

ClassCount.description: A result class and how many calls ended in it.

case.description:
The bounded case discriminator refining the class into its distinct
failure modes (RFC rule id(s), failed check id(s), the failed step
`<who>[:<kind>#<index>]@<barrier>`).
Empty = un-refined (`ok` rows, indexes written before the field existed).

error.description:
The first stored sample's one-line failure detail; `None` when the
bucket stores no sample with a detail.

judged.description:
The row's share of the calls its class judges on their recording;
`None` for a class judged on every call.

ok.description:
`true` iff the class is no failure (`ok`). Drives the OK-green / NOK-red
split.

FailureRow.description: One failed call among the run's last failures.

atMs.description: When the call ended, since the run started.

page.description:
The run-dir-relative path of the call's stored sample page, when it was
stored.

JudgedBasis.description: The recorded calls a failure row's class judges on their recording.

oneOf.description:
`rfc_audit_fail`: the accepted calls whose recording the audit judged,
standing for every accepted call.

`check_fail`: the calls whose case checks ran, standing for every
accepted call clean of the audit.

JudgedShare.description:
A failure row's share of the recorded calls its class judged, and the
estimate it gives over every call that class would judge.

base.description: Every call the class would judge.

failed.description: Judged calls that failed this row.

afterCall.description:
Failures judged after the call, on no arrow (`rfc_audit_fail`,
`check_fail`).

arrows.description: The arrows, by mean offset from call start (bounded).

beforeReply.description: Failures decided before any message came in.

engine.description:
Some call of the scenario ran the retransmit engine (re-sends are
counted only then).

lanes.description: The lanes, in display order: the caller, the SUT, the callee roles.

other.description: Every arrow past the bound, merged (`from`, `to` and `label` empty).

LadderArrow.description: One arrow of a ladder, merged over the calls.

errors.description:
Failed calls whose failure was detected here: the last message in
before the outcome.

label.description: `INVITE`, or the status and its CSeq method: `180 (INVITE)`.

meanOffsetMs.description: Mean offset of its first copy from call start (ms).

nth.description: Which distinct occurrence of `(from, to, label)` in its call (from 1).

LatencyRow.description: Per-scenario end-to-end latency summary (all values in milliseconds).

LoadRunMeta.description: Run metadata: timing and the echoed run knobs.

commandLine.description: The load generator's command line, as typed (program first).

cps.description: Offered call rate the run was configured for (calls/s).

egress.description:
The egress policy label the run realized its b-leg with
(`transparent` / `api-call-pin` / `registrar-aor`).

finished.description:
`false` while a periodic snapshot is written mid-run; `true` in the doc
written at run end.

finishedMs.description: Wall-clock finish (the moment this doc was written), Unix epoch ms.

maxInFlight.description: Max concurrent in-flight calls (offered load above this was shed).

profile.description: Optional load-profile description echoed from the run's `--load-profile`.

sampling.description: The sampling gate's bounds: which calls ran recorded.

target.description: The SUT ingress the INVITEs were routed through (the `lb`/VIP address).

Progress.description: The run's headline figures as of the doc.

draining.description: The run was drained: it places no new call.

failed.description: Calls ended in failure: every class but `ok` and `rejected`.

generatorFailures.description: Calls the generator itself failed: a run with one is invalid.

inFlight.description: Calls placed and not ended yet.

offered.description: Calls offered: every slot of the rate, placed or not.

offeringMs.description:
Time the run offered calls so far: the elapsed time up to the run's
duration or its drain, whichever came first.

ok.description: Calls ended on an accepted branch.

placed.description: Calls placed: started past the max-in-flight cap.

rejected.description: Calls of the `rejected` class: refused before any datagram.

retransmissionsReceived.description: Datagram copies received after the first, over every call.

retransmissionsResent.description: Datagram copies sent after the first, over every call.

retransmitEngine.description: Some call ran the retransmit engine (re-sends are counted only then).

targetCps.description:
The offered-rate target (calls/s) as of the doc: the configured rate
until a rate change moves it, `0` while paused.

RateEvent.description: One change of the offered rate, or the drain.

atMs.description: When it happened, since the run started.

toCps.description: The target after the event (equal to `fromCps` for a drain).

oneOf.description: The offered-rate target moved from `fromCps` to `toCps`.
The run was drained: no new call from then on.

SampleGroup.description: The stored sampled callflow pages for one `(scenario, class, case)` bucket.

Sampling.description: The sampling gate's bounds, as the run was configured.

chaseCalls.description:
Calls of its scenario a bucket under cap keeps recording after its
first call or its last sample.

recordEvery.description: 1 call of each scenario in this many records (`0`: none).

sampleCap.description:
Stored callflow samples per `(scenario, class, case)` bucket; also the
first calls of each scenario that record.

ScenarioRecording.description:
Per scenario: the calls placed and recorded, and the calls the RFC audit
judged.

accepted.description:
Calls that ended on an accepted branch before the RFC audit: the calls
the audit judges.

audited.description: Accepted calls whose recording the audit judged.

placed.description: Calls placed, as the sampling gate counts them.

SeriesPoint.description:
One window of the run's time series: what changed between its start and
its end.

failed.description: Calls ended in failure in the window (as [`Progress::failed`]).

ok.description: Calls ended ok in the window.

p50Ms.description:
End-to-end latency median of the calls ended in the window (`0` when
none, see [`Self::has_latency`]).

p99Ms.description: End-to-end latency 99th percentile of the calls ended in the window.

rejected.description: Calls refused before any datagram or shed at the cap in the window.

retransmissionsReceived.description: Retransmissions received by the calls ended in the window.

retransmissionsResent.description: Re-sends by the calls ended in the window.

startMs.description: Window start, since the run started.
